description: Training-only downstream gate for L9H7. Four cases per ten familiar edit types used to choose from four ranks and five spectral fit measures. Every designed type must have mean finite final-logit path relative MSE <= .10, and mean base-prompt forward KL <= .001. The minimal passing rank wins; within rank, minimize worst family path error. New edit families and validation cases are excluded from selection. Training cases also contributed to covariance fitting, so independent evaluation is required.
